integrity: The proofs and exact identities are contained in RESULT.md; CHECK.py contains standard-library finite symbolic/numeric checks and is not an infinite proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only a single derivative sampling node and a fixed jet order k>=2 are covered; finite-N ties at odd order and growing-order scaling are not determined. Priority against all GUE-density and displaced-state terminology is not certified.
title: A parity law for optimal single-site Fock jets and their Laguerre radius candidates
